verdict.rationale: Mailgun is a headless-first API/SDK product with REST APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and documented CI-friendly integrations like GitHub Actions and n8n, all of which support automation without a UI. However, evidence is largely first-party docs without independent CI/automation case studies or a formal CLI tool for scripting. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of running in CI pipelines, a dedicated CLI tool, and confirmation of headless operation at scale beyond docs.
